mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a contraction in consumer and business demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline by at least 0.5% from their prior 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (YoY) and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in year-over-year CPIAUCSL above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering expectations of monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (YoY).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.1 percentage points from their prior 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annually), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a cooling in the real estate sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 2.5% (annualized) and HOUST declines by at least 0.5%.
